requirements.text: The web application must provide a 'Settings' button, identifiable by the attribute data-testid='settings-btn'. When this button is clicked, it should toggle the visibility of the settings form, which is identifiable by the attribute data-testid='settings'. Initially, the settings form should be visible upon page load. The toggle functionality must handle rapid consecutive clicks, ensuring the form's visibility state changes accordingly with each click. The application should maintain a consistent user experience by ensuring the form's visibility state is accurately reflected after each interaction.

The web application must provide a settings form accessible via a button with data-testid 'settings-btn'. This form should allow users to select a difficulty level (Easy, Medium, Hard) from a dropdown menu with data-testid 'difficulty-select'. Upon selection, the difficulty level must be immediately updated in the application and stored in localStorage under the key 'difficulty', ensuring persistence across sessions. The settings form should toggle visibility when the settings button is clicked, and the difficulty selection should dynamically affect game mechanics, such as time adjustments upon correct word entry. The application must initialize with the difficulty level retrieved from localStorage, defaulting to 'Medium' if no prior selection exists.

The application must display a random word from a predefined list in the word display area with the attribute data-testid 'word' when the game starts or when the user types the correct word into the text input field with the attribute data-testid 'text-input'. Upon loading the Speed Typer page, the game initializes by selecting a random word from the list and displaying it. If the user correctly types the displayed word within the time limit, the text input field is cleared, and a new random word is displayed. This functionality should work regardless of whether the localStorage is empty or contains a previously set difficulty level. The difficulty level affects the time increment added upon typing the correct word: 5 seconds for 'easy', 3 seconds for 'medium', and 2 seconds for 'hard'.

The Speed Typer web application must allow users to interact with the game interface as follows: Users should be able to type words into the input field identified by the attribute data-testid='text-input'. When the typed word matches the word displayed in the element with data-testid='word' within the remaining time shown in the element with data-testid='time', the input field must be cleared automatically. The score, displayed in the element with data-testid='score', should increment by 1. Subsequently, a new random word from the predefined list should be displayed in the element with data-testid='word'. If the typed word is incorrect, the input field should retain the user's input, the score should remain unchanged, and the displayed word should not change. The game should continue until the time reaches zero, at which point the game ends, displaying a message and the final score in the element with data-testid='end-game-container'. The difficulty level, which affects the time increment upon correct word entry, can be adjusted via a settings menu toggled by clicking the button with data-testid='settings-btn'. The selected difficulty is stored in localStorage under the key 'difficulty' and retrieved upon page load to set the initial game state.

When the user types the correct word into the text input field (data-testid='text-input'), the remaining time displayed in the time element (data-testid='time') should increase based on the selected difficulty level. The difficulty level is determined by the value of the difficulty select dropdown (data-testid='difficulty-select'), which can be 'easy', 'medium', or 'hard'. Specifically: 'easy' increases time by 5 seconds, 'medium' increases time by 3 seconds, and 'hard' increases time by 2 seconds. The updated time should be reflected immediately in the time element. The difficulty setting is persistently stored in localStorage under the key 'difficulty', and the application should retrieve this value on page load to initialize the difficulty select dropdown and game behavior. The word element (data-testid='word') displays the current word to be typed, and upon correct entry, the text input field is cleared, a new word is displayed, and the score element (data-testid='score') is incremented by 1.

reference_cases.title: [Normal] Toggle settings form visibility
reference_cases.description:
Feature: Toggle Settings Form Visibility
  The settings form should toggle between visible and hidden states when the user clicks the 'Settings' button.


  Scenario: [Normal] Toggle settings form visibility
    Given the Speed Typer page is loaded
    And the settings form with data-testid "settings" is initially visible
    When the user clicks the 'Settings' button with data-testid "settings-btn"
    Then the settings form with data-testid "settings" should be hidden

reference_cases.title: [Normal] Toggle settings form visibility back to visible
reference_cases.description:
Feature: Toggle Settings Form Visibility
  The settings form should toggle between visible and hidden states when the user clicks the 'Settings' button.


Scenario: [Normal] Toggle settings form visibility back to visible
    Given the Speed Typer page is loaded
    And the user clicks the 'Settings' button with data-testid "settings-btn" to hide the settings form
    When the user clicks the 'Settings' button with data-testid "settings-btn" again
    Then the settings form with data-testid "settings" should be visible

reference_cases.title: [Edge] Rapidly clicking the 'Settings' button
reference_cases.description:
Feature: Toggle Settings Form Visibility
  The settings form should toggle between visible and hidden states when the user clicks the 'Settings' button.


  Scenario: [Edge] Rapidly clicking the 'Settings' button
    Given the Speed Typer page is loaded
    And the settings form with data-testid "settings" is initially visible
    When the user rapidly clicks the 'Settings' button with data-testid "settings-btn" multiple times
    Then the settings form with data-testid "settings" should toggle visibility accordingly

reference_cases.title: [Normal] User selects a difficulty level and it is saved to localStorage
reference_cases.description:
Feature: Difficulty Selection in Settings Form
  The settings form must allow the user to select a difficulty level (Easy, Medium, Hard) from a dropdown menu. The selected difficulty should be saved to localStorage and persist across sessions.


  Scenario: [Normal] User selects a difficulty level and it is saved to localStorage
    Given the Speed Typer page is loaded
    When the user selects "Hard" from the difficulty dropdown with data-testid "difficulty-select"
    Then the difficulty should be set to "Hard"
    And the localStorage should contain the key "difficulty" with value "Hard"

reference_cases.title: [Edge] User changes difficulty multiple times
reference_cases.description:
Feature: Difficulty Selection in Settings Form
  The settings form must allow the user to select a difficulty level (Easy, Medium, Hard) from a dropdown menu. The selected difficulty should be saved to localStorage and persist across sessions.


  Scenario: [Edge] User changes difficulty multiple times
    Given the Speed Typer page is loaded
    When the user selects "Easy" from the difficulty dropdown with data-testid "difficulty-select"
    Then the difficulty should be set to "Easy"
    And the localStorage should contain the key "difficulty" with value "Easy"
    When the user selects "Medium" from the difficulty dropdown with data-testid "difficulty-select"
    Then the difficulty should be set to "Medium"
    And the localStorage should contain the key "difficulty" with value "Medium"

reference_cases.title: [Normal] Display a random word when the game starts
reference_cases.description:
Feature: Display Random Word
  The application must display a random word from a predefined list in the word display area when the game starts or when the user types the correct word.


  Scenario: [Normal] Display a random word when the game starts
    Given the Speed Typer page is loaded
    When the game initializes
    Then a random word from the predefined list is displayed in the word display area with data-testid "word"

reference_cases.title: [Normal] Display a new random word after typing the correct word
reference_cases.description:
Feature: Display Random Word
  The application must display a random word from a predefined list in the word display area when the game starts or when the user types the correct word.


Scenario: [Normal] Display a new random word after typing the correct word
    Given the Speed Typer page is loaded
    And a random word is displayed in the word display area with data-testid "word"
    When the user enters the correct word into the text input field with data-testid "text-input" within the time limit
    Then the text input field should be cleared
    And a new random word from the predefined list should be displayed in the word display area with data-testid "word"

reference_cases.title: [Edge] Display a random word when the game starts with an empty localStorage
reference_cases.description:
Feature: Display Random Word
  The application must display a random word from a predefined list in the word display area when the game starts or when the user types the correct word.


  Scenario: [Edge] Display a random word when the game starts with an empty localStorage
    Given the Speed Typer page is loaded with an empty localStorage
    When the game initializes
    Then a random word from the predefined list is displayed in the word display area with data-testid "word"

reference_cases.title: [Normal] User types the correct word within the time limit
reference_cases.description:
Feature: User can type words and score points in the Speed Typer game
  The user must be able to type into the input field. If the typed word matches the currently displayed word within the time limit, the input field should be cleared, the score should increment by 1, and a new random word should be displayed.


Scenario: [Normal] User types the correct word within the time limit
    Given the Speed Typer page is loaded
    When the user enters the right word into the input field with data-testid "text-input" within the time limit
    Then the input field with data-testid "text-input" should be cleared
    And the score should be updated to "1" in the element with data-testid "score"
    And a new random word should be displayed in the element with data-testid "word"

reference_cases.title: [Normal] User types the correct word twice within the time limit
reference_cases.description:
Feature: User can type words and score points in the Speed Typer game
  The user must be able to type into the input field. If the typed word matches the currently displayed word within the time limit, the input field should be cleared, the score should increment by 1, and a new random word should be displayed.


Scenario: [Normal] User types the correct word twice within the time limit
    Given the Speed Typer page is loaded
    When the user enters the correct word into the input field with data-testid "text-input" within the time limit
    And the user enters the next correct word into the input field with data-testid "text-input" within the time limit
    Then the input field with data-testid "text-input" should be cleared
    And the score should be updated to "2" in the element with data-testid "score"
    And a new random word should be displayed in the element with data-testid "word"

reference_cases.title: [Normal] User types an incorrect word within the time limit
reference_cases.description:
Feature: User can type words and score points in the Speed Typer game
  The user must be able to type into the input field. If the typed word matches the currently displayed word within the time limit, the input field should be cleared, the score should increment by 1, and a new random word should be displayed.


Scenario: [Normal] User types an incorrect word within the time limit
    Given the Speed Typer page is loaded
    When the user enters an incorrect word "xxxxxxx" into the input field with data-testid "text-input" within the time limit
    Then the input field with data-testid "text-input" should not be cleared
    And the score should remain "0" in the element with data-testid "score"
    And the same word should still be displayed in the element with data-testid "word"

reference_cases.title: [Normal] User types the correct word on Medium difficulty
reference_cases.description:
Feature: Time Increase on Correct Word Entry
  The application should increase the remaining time based on the selected difficulty level when the user types the correct word.


Scenario: [Normal] User types the correct word on Medium difficulty
    Given the Speed Typer page is loaded
    And the difficulty is set to "medium" in the difficulty select with data-testid "difficulty-select"
    And the initial time is displayed in the time element with data-testid "time"
    And a word is displayed in the word element with data-testid "word"
    When the user types the displayed word correctly into the text input with data-testid "text-input"
    Then the time should increase by 3 seconds

reference_cases.title: [Normal] User types the correct word on Easy difficulty
reference_cases.description:
Feature: Time Increase on Correct Word Entry
  The application should increase the remaining time based on the selected difficulty level when the user types the correct word.


Scenario: [Normal] User types the correct word on Easy difficulty
	Given the Speed Typer page is loaded
	And the difficulty is set to "easy" in the difficulty select with data-testid "difficulty-select"
	And a word is displayed in the word element with data-testid "word"
	And the initial time is displayed in the time element with data-testid "time"
	When the user types the displayed word correctly into the text input with data-testid "text-input"
	Then the time should increase by 5 seconds

reference_cases.title: [Normal] User types the correct word on Hard difficulty
reference_cases.description:
Feature: Time Increase on Correct Word Entry
  The application should increase the remaining time based on the selected difficulty level when the user types the correct word.


Scenario: [Normal] User types the correct word on Hard difficulty
    Given the Speed Typer page is loaded
    And the difficulty is set to "hard" in the difficulty select with data-testid "difficulty-select"
    And the initial time is displayed as "10s" in the time element with data-testid "time"
    And a word is displayed in the word element with data-testid "word"
    When the user types the displayed word correctly into the text input with data-testid "text-input"
    Then the time should increase by 2 seconds
